Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
227 PM EDT Fri Oct 2 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM MIDNIGHT EDT TONIGHT THROUGH
SATURDAY AFTERNOON...

.THIS AFTERNOON...S winds 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TONIGHT...SW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming NW with gusts to 20 kt
late in the evening, then becoming N 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt
after midnight. Waves 1 to 2 ft. Showers likely. 
.SAT...N winds 10 to 15 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt until late afternoon.
Waves 2 ft. A chance of showers. 
.SAT NIGHT...E winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. A chance of showers. 
.SUN...E winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. Showers.
.SUN NIGHT...N winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. A chance of
showers. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.TUE...N winds 10 to 15 kt...diminishing to around 5 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft...subsiding to flat after midnight.
